target.name: Ibex-Simple-System-SecureIbex-v1
target.data_ind_timing: enabled by SecureIbex in pinned RTL

derivation: For classes 0..5 the bound is the mcycle-measured actual admission+infer_budget no-early-stop path on held-out test index 57, whose deployed policy prefers exit 5. Class 6 is the monotone maximum of class-5 and class-6 measurements because the deployed policy ceiling is exit 5. No multiplicative safety factor is used. Fixed-loop branchless numeric kernels, SecureIbex data-independent instruction timing, deterministic one-cycle SRAM and no cache make the no-stop class path the structural maximum; early stopping only removes suffix work.
nonclaims: This is an RTL-simulation timing binding, not an FPGA/ASIC silicon WCET certificate.
The old RTNN-IBEX-DIT-v1 arithmetic cycle formula is falsified for this pinned RTL configuration.
A second RTL run must pass against this table before status is promoted from candidate.
